text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx and timeouts for inference runtime 'redwood-large-v1' in us-west-2. Spike started ~14:05 UTC. Current: ~72% 5xx, ~18% timeouts on model requests. Auto-alert created.

tara: I'm on call — taking page. pinging @alex @maria for runtime + model context. I'll start triage.

alex: looking now. can you dump recent deploys/config changes? also need `kubectl -n inference logs` from model-runner pods.

maria: i saw a small canary earlier with high eviction rates, but it recovered. pulling logs from the affected nodes.

eng-runtime: past hour deploys: model-serving v2.13 rolled at 13:58 UTC (small batching refactor). No kernel upgrades.

eng-runtime: past-10m metrics snapshot pasted: cpu/gpu utilization spiky, kv-cache miss rate up 3x, coroutine queue length increased.

sre-ops: grabbing pod logs. tailing one of the failing model-runner pods now.

sre-ops: ```
[14:07:12] model-runner[pid=2245]: allocating kv cache 0x7f9c... size=8GB
[14:07:12] model-runner[pid=2245]: WARNING: cannot reserve contiguous memory, falling back to mmap
[14:07:13] model-runner[pid=2245]: runtime error: out of memory allocating buffer
[14:07:13] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 2245 (model-runner) total-vm:13000000kB, anon-rss:8200000kB
[14:07:13] model-runner: segfault at 0 ip 00007f... sp 00007ff... error 4 in libattention.so
[14:07:13] envoy proxy: 502 upstream connect error or disconnect
```

tara: looks like OOM + segfault in model-runner after kv-cache alloc. could be a regression from batching refactor causing larger allocations.

alex: agree. immediate mitigation: (1) roll back v2.13 to v2.12, (2) scale up replica count for redwood-large-v1 to spread load, (3) temporarily disable dynamic batching, (4) drain + reboot affected GPU node to clear leaked allocations.

maria: i'll prepare the rollback. jeff can you open a fast path to shift traffic to fallback model variant `redwood-large-v1-quant` (lighter memory) while we roll? @support_lead please stand by for customer comms.

jeff: on it — triggering traffic shift via rollout-bot.

incident-bot: rollout-bot: Starting traffic reroute: 60% -> redwood-large-v1-quant, 40% -> redwood-large-v1 (target) (action by jeff)

sre-ops: draining node infra-gpu-7 now. cordon + drain + reboot in progress.

sre-ops: ```bash
kubectl cordon infra-gpu-7 -n inference
kubectl drain infra-gpu-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n inference
# reboot node via cloud provider console
```

eng-runtime: rollback started to v2.12. disabling dynamic batching flag `--dynamic-batching=false` in the temporarily deployed config.

maria: rollback completed on 14:18 UTC for the cluster. scaling redwood-large-v1 replicas from 6 -> 12.

eng-runtime: metrics updating — preliminary: 5xx dropping from 72% -> 12% within 4m of rollback + traffic shift. latencies improving.

support_lead: Customer impact: observed ~15% of production requests routed to affected model. Top impacted customers list: EnterpriseCorp (10% of their calls failed), app-startup-inc (sporadic errors). Support tickets created: #INC-987, #INC-988. Status page updated (major degraded). cross-posting to #support.

customer-james: we saw errors around 14:06 UTC, major impact on our ingestion pipeline. thanks for quick triage, pls keep us updated.

tara: tagging SRE followup: need postmortem, root cause hypothesis: v2.13 batching changed allocation path leading to larger contiguous kv-cache requests that hit fragmentation -> OOM -> segfault in native kernel.

alex: agree on hypothesis. action items:
- eng-runtime: create reproducible test with high-batch inputs + memory profiler (owner: alex)
- eng-runtime: add safe-guard to fallback to smaller kv-cache allocation instead of segfault (owner: maria)
- infra/sre: add automated node memory fragmentation monitor + alert (owner: sre-ops)
- product/support: customer comms follow-ups and SLO credit evaluation (owner: support_lead)

maria: i've started a draft for the postmortem: /docs/postmortems/4741122334-inference-oom-draft. will assign and populate with timeline + mitigations.

jeff: reroute completed; current metrics: 5xx ~1.3%, timeouts ~0.6%. will keep monitoring for 30m.

support_lead: sent initial notification to EnterpriseCorp, queued follow-up with engineering summary.

tara: handing off night-oncall to jeff at 15:00 UTC. jeff — if error rate climbs >5% re-open pager.

jeff: taking handoff — ack. I'll monitor dashboards and escalate if it creeps.

eng-runtime: small note: we'll revert the batching refactor and put it behind feature flag with canary > 5% traffic only after memory profiling.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident status: mitigated. Postmortem underway. Severity: P1 -> downgraded to P2 after rollback and reroute.

tara: nice work team. post-incident checklist: ops runbook update, add kvcache allocation checks, QA regression test for batching. assigning owners in the doc.

support_lead: leaving a customer follow-up template in the postmortem. we'll propose SLO credit if root cause confirmed.

maria: quick note — we captured core dump from model-runner instance and uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/4741122334/core-model-runner-2245.dmp

alex: thanks — i'll run local reproduction against the core and share stack trace in the postmortem.

jeff: all good here for now. monitoring.

customer-james: appreciate the fast response. keeping ticket open for updates.

tara: handing thread to postmortem doc. closing pager for now. :thumbsup:
